name: HC-2000

tenures.source: Formed on-air at the fed's own Promo Card (11 April 1998) as 'the hardcore wrestlers of the future,' managed by Scorp; fought through the Championship Tournament and the TV Title Battle Royal.

caption: A self-declared 'hardcore' stable managed by Scorp, in a running feud with the wrestler Death throughout the fed's documented run.

name: Rail Road Express

tenures.source: Competed at the TV Title Battle Royal (29 April) and won the fed's own first Tag Team Championship at its first pay-per-view (10 May), managed by Sammy.

caption: The fed's own first Tag Team Champions, managed by Sammy, who went on to co-found the larger stable Revolution Zero the night they won the belts.

name: The Gods

tenures.source: Competed for the fed's own first Tag Team Championship at its first pay-per-view, managed by Hades; lost to Rail Road Express.

caption: A tag team managed by Hades, defeated in the fed's own inaugural Tag Team Championship match.
